thread:
maya_support: FYI customer reporting mid-stream drop on SSE when moving between two home APs. Partial JSON chunk, then socket FIN. They see billing for partial tokens. Repro attached (steps + pcap).

sam_mobile: Device/os? SDK version? any quick repro steps?

maya_support: Pixel 6, Android 13, app v4.3.2, mobile-sdk-js 2.1.0. Steps: connect to /v1/stream with `curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream?model=gpt-open-embedding"`, start stream, while streaming toggle Wi‑Fi off/on (or roam between APs). Happens ~3/5 attempts.

maya_support: Attaching trace id x-rc-trace:rc-9f3b, pcap at s3://redwood-support/pcaps/1766123456-acme-sse.pcap. Relevant log snippet: ```
> STREAM CHUNK: {"delta":"...", "tokens": 12}  
> SOCKET: recv returned 0, then FIN from client side after 210ms of silence
```

sam_mobile: Thanks. Can you paste the exact curl output (verbose) + SDK client keepalive config?

maya_support: curl -v -N output: ```
* Connected to api.redwood.ai (10.0.0.5) port 443 (#0)
> GET /v1/stream?model=chat-async HTTP/1.1
> Authorization: Bearer rtk_XXXXX
< HTTP/1.1 200 OK
< Content-Type: text/event-stream
data: {"id":"msg_123","text":"hello"}
# (network pause 180ms while AP reassoc)
< (partial data) data: {"id":"msg_123","text":"hello"
* Connection #0 to host api.redwood.ai left intact
```
SDK keepalive default is 30s. Token TTL is 60s refresh handled client-side.

ryan_infra: Do we see any gateway/nginx timeouts correlated? Can you share the request trace id and approximate clock?

maya_support: trace rc-9f3b at ~1766123459 UTC. Customer reported duplicate partial responses on reconnect too.

eng-oncall: Sounds like a micro blackhole during AP reassoc causes client TCP RTOs and then the client sends FIN and reconnects. Server treats partial SSE output as served tokens and billing triggers. We should consider: 1) server-side small-window retry for half-closed streams 2) suppress billing for <X tokens within reconnection window.

ops: Also check proxy keepalive and tcp_tw_reuse on gateway. If upstream closes early we might log a 499. Any 499/504 around that ts?

ryan_infra: Pulling gateway logs now. If we see 499 followed by immediate reconnect from same IP and trace header we'll correlate.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy rolling out with increased keepalive timeout at 1766123600 (rolling update).

sam_mobile: In the meantime, ask the customer to set SDK keepalive to 15s and enable immediate reconnect backoff (jittered) — reduces symptom frequency for AP jumps. Also suggest client hold token for 90s locally before refresh on reconnect.

elaine_support: Customer worried about billing for partial outputs. Any quick mitigation?

mike_billing: Escalate to billing-ops with case# S-1766123456. We can issue provisional credit if we confirm duplicated partial charges from reconnects. Need list of request IDs and charge timestamps.

eng-oncall: I'll prototype server-side bill-protection that marks tokens in streams as possibly transient for 5s after a socket close and avoid final charge until ack from client or finalization. Will raise PR and include a config flag.

maya_support: Action items: sam_mobile to provide a short repro script (curl + adb wifi toggle), ryan_infra to attach gateway logs + nginx 499s, eng-oncall to scoping PR for billing protection, maya_support will update customer in 24h and offer provisional credit request via mike_billing.

ops: +1 to plan. Keep me posted if deploy causes regressions.

sam_mobile: I'll drop the repro script here in a follow-up message.

maya_support: Thanks all — customer timeline: urgent but not P0. Will request pcap upload and ask them to test SDK keepalive tweak. :thumbsup: :eyes:

deploy-bot: Canary completed at 1766123605 without errors.

ryan_infra: Gateway logs: found 2x 499s at 1766123459 & 1766123462 matching rc-9f3b and same source IP. Attaching snippet s3://redwood-support/logs/gw-1766123459-499s.log

eng-oncall: Noted. Starting design doc for token-window suppression. ETA PR: ~48h.

mike_billing: Received initial request, logged S-1766123456. Will coordinate credits after infra confirms duplicate charge evidence.

maya_support: I'll update customer and CC billing. Thanks team.
